scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run db:local && wrangler dev --env dev
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply growth-dev --local --env dev && wrangler d1 execute growth-dev --local --env dev --file fixtures/demo-seed.sql
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:web && git diff --exit-code -- public || (echo 'public/ is out of date: run npm run build:web and commit' && exit 1)
